title: VTA Calendar — Feeds — Create — payload
description: A client creates a private iCalendar feed of the principal's calendar for a calendar application, choosing the contexts, what it carries and when it expires; the feed's address is returned once. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

label.description: What the principal calls it. Plain text.

contextIds.description: The contexts the feed covers; the caller has standing in each (VTI-CAL-050).

expiresAt.description: At most a year from now (VTI-CAL-052).

Response.title: VTA Calendar — Feeds — Create — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vta/calendar/feeds/create/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/calendar/feeds/create/0.1#response.

url.description: The feed's address, carrying at least 256 bits of randomness. Returned here and nowhere else; the VTA keeps only its digest (VTI-CAL-051). Give it to the calendar application; anyone holding it reads the feed.
